prompt:
{
  "features": [
    {
      "category": "codebase-understanding",
      "description": "Read and comprehend project structure, tech stack, and architecture",
      "steps": [
        "Read gleam.toml to understand dependencies and project configuration",
        "Read AGENTS.md to understand project instructions and workflow",
        "Read README.md if available for project overview",
        "List all files in src/ directory to understand module structure",
        "Read src/intent.gleam to understand CLI entry point",
        "Verify project compiles with 'gleam build'",
        "Verify tests pass with 'gleam test'",
        "Document key findings about architecture and tech stack"
      ],
      "passes": false
    },
    {
      "category": "beads-integration",
      "description": "Initialize and sync with beads issue tracking system",
      "steps": [
        "Run 'bd status' to check beads installation",
        "Run 'bd ready' to list unblocked issues",
        "Read .beads/issues.jsonl to understand issue structure",
        "Document current issue state and priorities",
        "Run 'bv --robot-triage' to get comprehensive issue analysis",
        "Identify high-priority issues (0-1) to tackle first"
      ],
      "passes": false
    },
    {
      "category": "codebase-interrogation",
      "description": "Analyze each source file for code quality and opportunities",
      "steps": [
        "Read src/intent/types.gleam to understand core type definitions",
        "Read src/intent/parser.gleam to understand JSON parsing logic",
        "Read src/intent/loader.gleam to understand CUE file loading",
        "Read src/intent/runner.gleam to understand test orchestration",
        "Read src/intent/checker.gleam to understand validation logic",
        "Read src/intent/http_client.gleam to understand HTTP client implementation",
        "Read src/intent/resolver.gleam to understand dependency resolution",
        "Read src/intent/rules_engine.gleam to understand rule evaluation",
        "Read src/intent/anti_patterns.gleam to understand anti-pattern detection",
        "Read src/intent/rule.gleam to understand rule parsing",
        "Read src/intent/interpolate.gleam to understand variable interpolation",
        "Read src/intent/output.gleam to understand result formatting",
        "Identify code smells, duplication, and refactoring opportunities",
        "Document findings with file paths and line numbers"
      ],
      "passes": false
    },
    {
      "category": "tdd15-workflow",
      "description": "Apply 15-phase TDD workflow to refactor identified code issues",
      "steps": [
        "Load tdd15-gleam skill to get TDD workflow instructions",
        "Select first issue or code problem identified",
        "Phase 0: Verify existing tests for the code being refactored",
        "Phase 1: Write failing test for new behavior (RED)",
        "Phase 2: Run test to confirm failure",
        "Phase 3: Write minimal code to make test pass (GREEN)",
        "Phase 4: Run test to confirm passing",
        "Phase 5: Refactor code while keeping tests green",
        "Phase 6-15: Apply additional TDD phases as needed",
        "Verify all tests still pass with 'gleam test'",
        "Verify build succeeds with 'gleam build'",
        "Commit changes with descriptive message"
      ],
      "passes": false
    },
    {
      "category": "beads-issue-resolution",
      "description": "Work through beads issues systematically using TDD",
      "steps": [
        "Run 'bd ready' to get next available issue",
        "Read issue details from .beads/issues.jsonl",
        "Claim issue with 'bd update <id> --status in_progress'",
        "Apply tdd15-gleam workflow to implement or fix the issue",
        "Write tests first, then implementation",
        "Verify all tests pass",
        "Update issue with 'bd close <id> --reason \"Completed via TDD\"'",
        "Sync beads state with 'bd sync'",
        "Commit changes including .beads/issues.jsonl",
        "Proceed to next issue"
      ],
      "passes": false
    },
    {
      "category": "quality-gates",
      "description": "Run all quality checks to ensure code health",
      "steps": [
        "Run 'gleam build' to verify compilation",
        "Run 'gleam test' to verify all tests pass",
        "Check for test coverage gaps",
        "Run 'gleam format' to ensure code formatting",
        "Verify no compiler warnings",
        "Document any quality issues found"
      ],
      "passes": false
    },
    {
      "category": "code-consolidation",
      "description": "Identify and eliminate code duplication across modules",
      "steps": [
        "Search for duplicate function patterns across src/ files",
        "Identify common patterns in error handling",
        "Identify common patterns in HTTP request/response handling",
        "Identify common patterns in type conversions",
        "Extract common utilities to shared modules",
        "Update callers to use consolidated functions",
        "Verify all tests still pass",
        "Refactor for DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principle"
      ],
      "passes": false
    },
    {
      "category": "error-handling-review",
      "description": "Improve error handling throughout the codebase",
      "steps": [
        "Review all functions returning Result types",
        "Ensure proper error messages are provided",
        "Verify error types are meaningful and actionable",
        "Add error context where missing",
        "Ensure errors bubble up appropriately",
        "Add tests for error cases",
        "Verify error handling follows Gleam best practices"
      ],
      "passes": false
    },
    {
      "category": "documentation-update",
      "description": "Ensure code and documentation are in sync",
      "steps": [
        "Verify all public functions have documentation comments",
        "Update AGENTS.md if workflow has changed",
        "Check if README.md needs updates based on code changes",
        "Add inline comments for complex logic",
        "Document any new APIs or interfaces added"
      ],
      "passes": false
    },
    {
      "category": "session-completion",
      "description": "Complete work session and push changes to remote",
      "steps": [
        "File beads issues for any discovered but unaddressed work",
        "Run all quality gates (build, test, format)",
        "Close finished beads issues",
        "Run 'git pull --rebase' to sync with remote",
        "Run 'bd sync' to sync issue state",
        "Run 'git push' to push all changes",
        "Verify 'git status' shows 'up to date with origin'",
        "Clean up any stashes or temporary branches",
        "Provide session summary with context for next iteration"
      ],
      "passes": false
    },
    {
      "category": "continuous-improvement",
      "description": "Iterate through all beads issues until all are resolved",
      "steps": [
        "Run 'bd ready' to check for remaining issues",
        "If issues remain, claim next highest priority issue",
        "Apply tdd15-gleam workflow to issue",
        "Complete issue and close in beads",
        "Repeat until 'bd ready' returns no issues",
        "Perform final codebase review",
        "Ensure all tests pass",
        "Complete session with proper git push"
      ],
      "passes": false
    }
  ]
}
